_comment: M5 H2 movement-first combat input (consultant B4): arrows step the active unit directly during the player's turn (spending move pool, refused steps spend nothing). UI wave item 15: Dash (slot 2) now requires an Enter confirm before it fires. Ends mid-combat on purpose. ONBOARDING O5: the PC is CLASSLESS at boot now, but this script needs the WARRIOR kit fielded (slot 3 = [Power Strike], the _bb_escape regression tooth) AND a deterministic in-arena trajectory (the manual cell asserts assume the pc's opening corner stays clear as relc's AI moves off its spawn). Both are met by starting from the shared post_tutorial FIXTURE (warrior L1, rusty_sword equipped -> power_strike fielded, met_relc -> relc allied, floodplains 7,6) via the title 'Continue' load: the fixture sets rng.state directly (int of its rng_state), so goblin_encounter_2 -- the FIRST combat after load, drawing rng.randi() straight from that state with no pre-fight combat consuming rng -- is deterministic per the fixture, not per --seed. This script is post_tutorial's outcome-defining consumer; its rng_state is tuned so relc vacates the pc's west corner. Ends mid-fight, so no victory assert.
